correctness.rationale: For each q=2^m, every Hermitian rank-one idempotent is uniquely P(a,z) with N(z)=a²+a and there are q(q−1). Pair addition reduces to Tr_{K/F}(z w^q)=s²+s+N(w). In the nonscalar case, relative-trace parameterization and absolute Artin–Schreier solvability yield q/2 admissible z and two diagonal choices unless a coefficient vanishes; in the exceptional branch the constant absolute trace equals one and there are none. The vanishing coefficient is exactly N(w)∈{s²,(s+1)²}. Scalar cases, norm fibers and energy are explicitly counted. Four finite fields were independently enumerated, with all targets checked; finite testing does not substitute for the all-m proof.

originality.rationale: The checked primary papers solve different implication domains: Fulton (1977), Theorem 5.1, counts XAX* = B by rank without fixing the norms of the two columns of a projector pair; Gow–Lavrauw–Sheekey–Vanhove (2012), §§3–4, studies Hermitian rank-distance families and rank-only character data rather than a fixed trace-one idempotent orbit; Orel–Kuzma (2009), Theorem 2.1, addresses additive rank nonincreasing maps. Prior non-Hermitian and dyadic projector convolution records do not imply the present self-adjoint finite-unitary fiber law. Exact/alias queries did not identify an equivalent stronger statement; this is bounded originality, not absolute priority certification.
residual_risks: An unlocated representation-count or finite-unitary orbit theorem could re-express the same three-valued convolution.
A full formal proof of the absolute historical priority across older specialized finite-classical-group literature was not possible; negative searches are not proof of novelty.

value.rationale: This is the exact additive-convolution support and all-fiber census for the canonical unitary orbit of rank-one Hermitian idempotents in every binary field, not a selected small example. It identifies the precise characteristic-two Artin–Schreier obstruction, a two-point exceptional stratum, a natural exact sumset density and additive energy. These invariants matter for additive geometry and harmonic moments of this orbit; neither correctness nor computation alone is used to justify value.
